decision.explanation: The central register entry (D-UUN9M, issued 2027-10-03) names Dorhol Dorstanar (100%) as beneficial owner. The customer's self-declaration (D-U07SY) names someone else, Eliven Kastamnar (100%). Under R1 the self-declaration is a tier 3 source, so it cannot confirm or contradict the register. The internal risk record (D-ET6YS) rates the customer standard risk and shows no alerts, but it does not say who the beneficial owners are. Under R2 the register must never be relied on alone. Because no tier 1 or tier 2 source other than the register identifies the beneficial owners, the discrepancy determination cannot be made. The customer's declaration also conflicts with the register. We should therefore request a reliable document, such as a current business-register shareholder excerpt or a notarial deed, and clarification of the conflicting declaration, before deciding whether to report a discrepancy.

The central BO register entry (D-UUN9M, issued 2027-10-03) names Dorhol Dorstanar (b. 1987-02-09, 100%) as beneficial owner. The tier 1 Aurelia Business Register shareholder excerpt (D-90LD5, issued 2027-09-17, so current at 18 days old) shows the same person as 100% shareholder since 2025-02-13. The register therefore matches the reliable evidence. However, the customer's self-declaration (D-U07SY, 2027-10-02) names a different person, Eliven Kastamnar (b. 1978-04-12, 100%). Under R2, when the customer's own declaration names different beneficial owners than the reliable evidence, we must request clarification or escalate. We cannot simply conclude there is no discrepancy. The internal risk record (D-ET6YS) shows a standard rating and no alerts, so mandatory escalation for concealment does not apply. The action is to request clarification and supporting documents from the customer about the conflicting declaration.

The central register entry (D-UUN9M, last updated 2026-03-20) names Dorhol Dorstanar (born 1987-02-09) as the 100% beneficial owner. The Aurelia Business Register shareholder excerpt (D-90LD5) is a tier 1 source and is current: it was issued 2027-09-17, 18 days before the decision date. It shows Eliven Kastamnar (born 1978-04-12) as the 100% shareholder since 2026-06-07. These are two different people, so this is a real discrepancy and not a typo or transliteration error. The register looks out of date, but exception (b) also requires the evidence to come from a source independent of the register's controlling authority. No document shows that the business register and the beneficial-ownership register answer to different authorities, so the exception cannot be relied on. The customer is rated standard risk and has no internal alerts (D-ET6YS), so escalation isn't required. The default action therefore applies: report the discrepancy to the register within 14 calendar days.

Exception R2(b) is therefore met: the customer is asked to correct the register entry instead of a report being filed.
